title: Armor
html:
Armor is considered any item that is worn except weapons.

There are 6 different types of armor and 2 different types of jewelry in Dungeon Runners:

  • Body
  • Boots
  • Headpiece
  • Gloves
  • Shoulders
  • Shields
  • Rings
  • Amulets

With the exception of rings, only one of each type of armor may be worn at any time. While there is no distinctions between "classes" in Dungeon Runners, there are different kinds of each armor type that better suit certain character builds. For example, hard plate armor often has high bonuses to STR and END as well as high Armor Rating which better suit a Warrior character build. On the other side of the spectrum, soft cloth armor often has high bonuses to INT or AGI and END as well as a low Armor Rating which better suits a Mage character build. There are also different kinds of armor that fall in between these two extremes.

Armor has minimum level requirements but there are no minimum attribute requirements. As long as your character is at the same level or higher as the item requires, the item can be equipped. This system provides the player with the option to mix and match different armor types in order to achieve the desired balance of attributes and other modifiers.
